timeline.speaker: sora
timeline.text: [emphasis] Anthropic just locked in five hundred eighteen billion dollars of cloud computing. And eighty percent of it, they cannot cancel.
timeline.headline: $518B ANTHROPIC CAN'T CANCEL
timeline.detail: The buildout nobody can walk away from.

timeline.speaker: sora
timeline.text: [soft tone] The lab says it expects to spend at least five hundred eighteen billion dollars over ten years with six partners. One hundred eleven billion with Google. A hundred ten with Amazon. Thirty one point four with Microsoft. Payable whether or not they use it.
timeline.headline: THE DEALS YOU PAY FOR IDLE
timeline.detail: If actual spend falls short, they still pay Google the difference.

timeline.speaker: sora
timeline.text: [curious] Anthropic told investors that AI's future demand will be limited principally by the availability of compute. Then it shelved a safety push and shipped an always-on agent that keeps working after you close the chat.
timeline.headline: OPENAI SHIPS DOTS
timeline.subhead: Always-On Agent · Runs After Chat Closes
timeline.detail: Powered by GPT-6 Astra. Pro and Business Premium only.

timeline.speaker: sora
timeline.text: [emphasis] And at the White House, AI leaders signed an accord pledging robust internal controls. Asked whether it was binding, the president said: I think it's morally binding.
timeline.headline: AN ACCORD WITH NO TEETH
timeline.detail: A promise the signatories police themselves.

timeline.speaker: sora
timeline.text: [chuckling] Five hundred eighteen billion dollars of compute, one always-on agent, and one voluntary accord. That's the morning. I'm Sora.
timeline.headline: ONE NUMBER TO REMEMBER
timeline.detail: Rose verifies. Sora delivers. Every morning.
